result.instructions: Tools for Airtable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bases can I access, and what tables are in our CRM base?"; "List the open rows in the Projects table where Status is 'In progress', sorted by due date."; "Add three new leads to the Leads table with name, email and source.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Airtable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run airtable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run airtable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run airtable_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. airtable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: airtable_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected user
tools.description: Return the Airtable user id of the connected token and, when the token has the user.email:read scope, the email. Good first call to check the connection. Web API: GET /v0/meta/whoami.

tools.name: airtable_list_bases
tools.title: List bases
tools.description: List the bases (id, name, permission level) this token can access, 1000 per page. Use it to find a base id. Web API: GET /v0/meta/bases.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the previous call.

tools.name: airtable_get_base_schema
tools.title: Get base schema
tools.description: Return the tables, fields and views of one base: ids, names, field types and view ids. Use it before reading records. Web API: GET /v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/tables.

include_visible_field_ids.description: Also return the visible field ids of each grid view.

tools.name: airtable_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List records in one table, one page at a time (up to 100 per page). Supports a view, an Airtable filterByFormula, sort, a field subset and a max count. If the result has an offset, pass it back to get the next page. Web API: GET /v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}.

table.description: Table id (preferred, e.g. tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) or table name.

view.description: View id or name. Only its records are returned.

filter_by_formula.description: Airtable formula, e.g. {Status} = 'Open'. Keep the request URL under 16,000 characters.

sort.description: Sort order, applied in list order.

max_records.description: Stop after this many records in total.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the previous call.

tools.name: airtable_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Return one record by id, with its cell values. Web API: GET /v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}.

table.description: Table id (preferred, e.g. tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) or table name.

tools.name: airtable_create_records
tools.title: Create records
tools.description: Create 1 to 10 records in one table. Each record is a set of cell values keyed by field name. Creates new rows that cannot be undone by this server. Web API: POST /v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}.

table.description: Table id (preferred, e.g. tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) or table name.

fields.description: Cell values keyed by field name or field id.

typecast.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the cell types (e.g. '5' to a number). Default off.

tools.name: airtable_update_records
tools.title: Update records
tools.description: Update 1 to 10 existing records by id. Only the fields you send change (PATCH); other cells stay as they are. Overwrites the sent cell values. Web API: PATCH /v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}.

table.description: Table id (preferred, e.g. tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) or table name.

fields.description: Cell values keyed by field name or field id.

records.description: 1 to 10 records, each with its id and the cell values to change.

typecast.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the cell types. Default off.

prompts.title: Get started with Airtable
prompts.description: What you can do with Airtable here, with example requests to try.
